floorPlans.label: Nshama Augusta official apartment plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the developer’s published one-, two- and three-bedroom apartment layouts.
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Ranges follow the printed minimum and maximum figures. The official set skips 2 BR Type C. Printed totals are retained where component sums differ, including the 3 BR Type A minimum and 2 BR Type F minimum. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 8 project renders from Nshama’s own live gallery. One image of foundation works from the 10 September 2026 DLD album for project 3649, mirrored by Continental Club. The Augusta name appears on the project board in another frame. Inspection record https://continentalclub.ae/project/augusta-town-square-town-square/.
review.location: Project location confirmed on brochure physical page 8 and compared with the published building point. The display isolates the complete master-plan panel. The six time estimates are from page 6 and describe the community.
review.floorPlans: All 12 original physical pages of the official apartment plan PDF. Area tables checked visually. The official set skips 2 BR Type C. Printed totals are retained where component sums differ, including the 3 BR Type A minimum and 2 BR Type F minimum.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, completed-building photography and as-built individual unit schedules.
